candidates.name: CIG Raton Basin Expansion (Campo Lateral loops)

candidates.name: CIG Valley Line Expansion

evidence.note: FERC notice CP01-45: about 119 miles of 20 and 24 inch pipeline in two sections plus 4,450 hp at Fort Lupton
EIA 119 mi, 20/24 in, +282 MMcf/d, in service 2002

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row; only P0168. One search snippet says 53 miles of 24 inch built, which may overlap the Front Range line (PSCo/CIG); check against that candidate before adding.

candidates.name: Front Range Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Public Service Co of Colorado (with CIG alliance)
candidates.from: Chalk Bluffs Hub near CO-WY border

evidence.note: FERC notice for CP98-49 Front Range project
EIA 53 mi, 24 in, +269 MMcf/d, in service 1998

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row. NGI describes a 53-mile 24 inch line, 269,000 Dth/d, Chalk Bluffs to Fort St. Vrain, a PSCo and CIG alliance. Possible overlap with Valley Line 53-mile section; vetting should reconcile.

candidates.name: Coos Bay Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Coos County Pipeline Co (Coos County, Oregon)
candidates.from: Roseburg area, Douglas County, OR (Williams Northwest meter)

evidence.note: NGI trade report on the Coos County Roseburg to Coos Bay pipeline
Federal Register item on the Coos Bay line / Williams Northwest
EIA 72.4 mi, 4/6/12 in, intrastate, in service 2004

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row. Sources vary: about 50 to 65 miles of 12 inch mainline plus 4 and 6 inch laterals; all above 15.5 mi. Intrastate, county owned; Oregon PUC records could settle length.

candidates.name: East Side Expansion Project (Columbia loops, PA and NJ)

evidence.note: FERC notice CP14-17: about 19.1 miles of 20 and 26 inch loop in PA and NJ, 312,000 Dth/d
EIA 19 mi, 20 in, +312 MMcf/d, in service Oct 2015

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row. Pipe is split about 9.5 mi PA and 9.5 mi NJ across two loops, so each loop is under 25 km; total 19.1 mi (30.7 km). Starts in PA, which is outside this slice: out_of_slice true, route to the Appalachian region owner.

candidates.name: Willcox Lateral
